summary: Conditional two-part cleanup of network-object state on game exit. First clears the object pointer at obj+0x3FB8 (vtable call with the stored argument at +0x417C, then pointer validation, then zeroing) when that pointer is nonzero. Second resets a flag block at this+0x1B790 and, when the pointer at obj+0x1B79C is nonzero, runs network cleanup on it and zeroes it. Invoked from GameExit (0042DB20).

local_names.v5: object base pointer obtained by dereferencing this
local_names.v6: object pointer at obj+0x3FB8 pending first cleanup
local_names.v3: secondary object pointer at obj+0x1B79C pending cleanup
local_names.result: value propagated from the flag-reset side-effect routine (or the network cleanup result)

operations.description: Dereferences this to obtain the object base pointer v5 = *this, then reads the first cleanup candidate v6 = *(v5 + 0x3FB8)
If the pointer at obj+0x3FB8 is nonzero, perform the vtable call, pointer check, and clear; otherwise skip that block entirely
VTableCallViaOffset0x7c(v6, *(v5 + 0x417C)): calls the virtual method at vtable offset 0x7C on the object at obj+0x3FB8, passing the stored argument from obj+0x417C
PointerCheckWithFallback(this + 0x3FB8): validates the pointer being cleared, with fallback handling
Clears the first pointer slot to 0: *(obj + 0x3FB8) = 0
Computes the flag block base v1 = this + 112528 (0x1B790), where the secondary object pointer lives at v1 + 12 (obj + 0x1B79C)
BooleanFlagResetWithSideEffects(v1): resets a flag at the start of the block this+0x1B790, returning a value carried as result
If the pointer at obj+0x1B79C is nonzero, run network cleanup and clear it; otherwise leave it untouched
NetworkCleanup(v3): tears down the secondary network object pointed to by obj+0x1B79C
Clears the secondary pointer slot to 0: *(obj + 0x1B79C) = 0
Returns result (the flag-reset side-effect value, or the network-cleanup result when the second block ran)
Invoked from GameExit (0042DB20) to perform network-object cleanup during game shutdown
